title: Smartphone Case-Generator Universal, every phone
author: Manufact3D_HH
description:
**Welcome to my MakerWorld page!**

Here you will find high-quality, cleanly designed, and everyday 3D models – developed with a focus on function, reliability, and straightforward printing.

### 📱 Ultimate Smartphone Case for Everyone!!

**Universal Smartphone Case Generator (Parametric, OpenSCAD)**

A fully parametric generator for precision-fit smartphone cases—ideal if you can't find a matching case or want to define every detail yourself. Simply enter your device's dimensions, adjust openings and buttons, and export your individual case as an STL.

🚀 **Start your own Phone Case Business!** With my **Standard/Premium License**, you get more than just a file. You get the full **OpenSCAD Framework** to create custom-fit cases for any smartphone.

- **Sell custom cases** for niche phone models.
- **Adjust fit & thickness** for your customers.
- **One license – infinite possibilities.**

**Version 2 is online for PETG/PLA/ABS/ASA**

https://makerworld.com/de/models/2369821

#### 🛠 Features

- **Millimeter-precise input** for length, width, and height
- **Exact positioning** for USB-C/Lightning, speakers, microphone, and AUX
- **Freely definable button zones** (Power, Volume)
- **Negative volumes** for cameras, sensors, or custom shapes
- **Adjustable wall thickness** for smooth button actuation
- **2 mm display bezel** for enhanced drop protection

#### 🧵 Optimized for TPU

The design is specifically engineered for flexible TPU—easy to snap on, secure fit.

#### 🚀 How to Use

1. Open the **.scad file** in OpenSCAD
2. Enter your values in the **Customizer** 3\. Export the **STL** 4\. Print

#### 🖨 Print Recommendations

- **Material:** TPU 95A or softer
- **Infill:** 15–25%
- **Walls:** At least 3 wall lines
